data.name: Tobarian
data.long_meaning: The name Tobias (Tobarian) has its roots in Hebrew language. It is derived from the Hebrew word ‘Tov’ which means ‘good’. This name was borne by two biblical figures, Tobias and Tobiah. Tobias, the hero of the apocryphal book of the same name, is a kind and faithful man who, guided by the angel Raphael, embarks on a perilous journey to retrieve his bride-to-be Sarah from her captivity in Assyria. The name symbolizes God’s goodness and the blessings that come from following His commandments.

in_hebrew.name: טובאריאן
in_hebrew.meaning: טוב ואריאן - טוב הוא השם האלוהי לטוב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: טובאריאן הוא שם המשלב את המילה 'טוב' שפירושה טוב, אלוהי, ו'אריאן' שיכול להיות קשור למילה 'אריה' שפירושה אריה, או 'עוריאן' שפירושה אור. השם יכול להתפרש כ'טוב הוא האור האלוהי' או 'טוב כאריה האלוהי'.

in_greek.name: Τοβαριαν
in_greek.long_meaning: Τοβαριαν είναι ένα όνομα που συνδυάζει το 'τοβαρος' που σημαίνει καλό, και το 'αρειος' που σημαίνει άριστος ή λιοντάρι. Το όνομα μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως 'καλό λιοντάρι' ή 'ο άριστος καλός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η λέξη 'αγαθος' (αγαθός) χρησιμοποιείται συχνά για να περιγράψει το Θεό και τα καλά του έργα.

in_latin.name: Tobarian
in_latin.long_meaning: Tobarian est nomen quod coniungit 'bonus' quod significat good, et 'fortis' quod significat strong. Nomen interpretari potest ut 'bonus et fortis' vel 'bonus leo'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen 'bonus' ad Deum et eius opera bona referebatur.

in_english.name: Tobarian
in_english.meaning: Tobarian means good and strong, derived from Hebrew and Greek roots
in_english.long_meaning: Tobarian is a Christian name that combines the Hebrew word 'tov' (טוב) meaning good, and the Greek or Latin suffix '-arian' suggesting strength or belonging. The name may be interpreted as 'good lion' or 'strong and good'. Etymologically, it relates to biblical concepts of goodness and strength, reflecting divine attributes. Historically, names with similar roots were used in early Christian traditions to signify virtues and spiritual qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tobias (Tobarian) has cultural significance in the Jewish, Christian, and Syriac traditions, where the name Tobias is featured in various apocryphal and biblical texts. In these stories, Tobias is depicted as a kind, faithful, and obedient man who trusts in God and His angels to guide him through trials and tribulations. The name Tobias has been popular among these communities for its positive connotations of goodness, courage, and faithfulness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Tobias (Tobarian) carries significant spiritual meaning for Christians, as it reminds us of the goodness and mercy of God. Tobias is a model of faithfulness and obedience to God, who guides us through life's challenges and blesses us with strength and courage. As Tobias trusted in God and His angel Raphael to help him rescue his bride-to-be, we too can trust in God to help us navigate life's trials and obstacles. The name Tobias also highlights the importance of kindness and compassion, as Tobias demonstrated throughout his journey in the biblical story. In sum, the name Tobias (Tobarian) is a reminder of God's goodness and the blessings that come from living a faithful and obedient life.

historical_references.reference: Tobit, an ancient Assyrian Jew, is the central character of the biblical Book of Tobit. The book is believed to have been written during the 3rd century BCE and is a part of the Apocrypha in the Christian Old Testament.
historical_references.context: Ancient Assyrian Jew and central character of the biblical Book of Tobit

historical_references.reference: In the New Testament, the name Tobias is mentioned in the Gospel of John (21:1-14) as one of the disciples of Jesus who went fishing with Peter after His resurrection. There is no consensus on whether this Tobias is the same as the Tobit from the Old Testament.
historical_references.context: One of the disciples of Jesus who went fishing with Peter after His resurrection
